newsitem.title: USA: Samsonite files for 7.8 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: Samsonite files for 7.8 mln common shares.

text.p: Samsonite Corp filed Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to 7,823,156 common shares.
Of the total, the luggage company will sell up to 3.0 million shares while certain shareholders may sell up to 4,823,156 shares.
The offering will be made through a group of underwriters led by Merrill Lynch & Co. The underwriters have an over-allotment option for up to 782,315 additional shares.
The company estimated net proceeds at $105.7 million, assuming the shares are sold for $37.50 each.
It said net proceeds will be used to repay debt. It will not receive proceeds from the sale by the shareholders, it said.
The selling shareholders are investors Carl Icahn and Steven Green. Icahn plans to sell up to 3,138,003 shares, which will reduce his stake to 1.57 percent, from 21.54 percent.

Green, who resides in Fisher Island, Fla., plans to sell up to 1,685,153 common shares, which will cut his stake to 168,515 shares or less than one percent of the total outstanding, from 15.35 percent.
